saturation.overdose_rule: If saturation after dose exceeds 100, excess becomes deterministic toxicity burden of the same amount.

rules: No recipe is generated at runtime. Pills and medicines never erase anatomical damage; they modify registered recovery/resource processes only.
Production has no random quality roll. Sufficient registered inputs, facility, professional skill, labor and time produce the fixed batch.
Facility level, Medicine skill, conserved ingredients and labor hours are mandatory inputs to every batch.
No medicine recipe directly restores Qi or grants cultivation progress. Qi is developed only by cultivation/training and recovered only by elapsed-time physiology/Qi-Control rules.

administration.inventory_rule: One dose is removed from the exact holder before effect application. A missing dose rejects the administration.
administration.settlement_rule: Saturation and toxicity decay by exact elapsed minutes before every new dose and time boundary. Active effects expire at registered timestamps.
administration.healing_rule: Medicines create registered recovery modifiers only. Anatomy, bleeding, fracture, tendon, nerve and organ state remain health-system authority.
administration.toxicity_rule: Medicine toxicity is a persisted physiological burden. It deterministically adds fatigue/coordination burden, then shock and organ stress above registered thresholds; it is never only a descriptive label.
administration.qi_rule: No medicine restores Current Qi, increases Maximum Qi, grants Qi training credit, or substitutes for cultivation. Qi recovery is owned by elapsed rest/health/Qi-Control settlement.

physicians_kit.rule: Enables advanced diagnosis/stabilization procedures; it does not add flat Medicine skill.

medical_supply_bundle.rule: Aggregate routine dressings, splinting and treatment expendables; one bundle is consumed by qualifying treatment.

deterministic_formulas.diagnosis: 60% Medicine + 25% Intelligence + 15% Perception, then observation/time/tool/environment modifiers
deterministic_formulas.wound_treatment: 55% Medicine + 20% Dexterity + 15% Intelligence + 10% Perception, then injury/tool/supply/environment/time modifiers
deterministic_formulas.poison_treatment: 65% Medicine + 25% Intelligence + 10% Perception, then toxin/burden/antidote/patient cultivation/facility modifiers
